result.brief: 提出4D VAE将RGB与点图序列编码为紧凑时空潜变量，并结合循环扩散Transformer实现具身操作场景的RGB-几何联合预测。
result.reason: Contributes 4D VAE encoding RGB and pointmaps into spatiotemporal latents with geometry-guided supervision, plus looped diffusion transformer for embodied world modeling; representation contribution is central.
